item.title: To the editor: Story we keep forgetting
item.description: As immigration and immigration enforcement once again dominate the news cycle, it is worth remembering a story America seems determined to forget. The United States was built by immigrants. This is not a slogan or a sentimental flourish — it is a historical fact, one that has shaped the nation from its earliest days.

item.title: Editorial: Data study delay
item.description: The proposed Data Study Commission under consideration in Columbus is a classic example of a day late and a dollar short in the Ohio General Assembly.

item.title: Harden scores 22 points with broken thumb, leads Cavaliers over the Nets 106-102
item.description: NEW YORK — James Harden scored 22 points in his return to the lineup with a broken thumb and the Cleveland Cavaliers snapped a two-game skid with a 106-102 victory over the Brooklyn Nets on Sunday.

item.title: Tyler Reddick makes NASCAR history at COTA with 3rd straight win to start the season
item.description: AUSTIN — Tyler Reddick's latest win drove him straight into the NASCAR record books.

item.title: Walleye goalie Gylander makes 45 saves, posts shutout to complete perfect weekend homestand
item.description: Perfection came at the perfect time for the Toledo Walleye on Sunday at the Huntington Center, where goaltender Carter Gylander put on a show with a shutout in net.

item.title: Cunningham, Harris help NBA-leading Pistons beat Magic for 6th straight road victory
item.description: ORLANDO, Fla. — Cade Cunningham had 29 points and 11 assists, Tobias Harris scored 23 points, and the NBA-leading Detroit Pistons beat the Orlando Magic 106-92 on Sunday night for their sixth straight road victory.

item.title: FBI probes Texas bar shooting that killed 2 and wounded 14 as possible terrorist act
item.description: AUSTIN — A gunman wearing clothes with an Iranian flag design and the words “Property of Allah” killed two people and wounded 14 early Sunday at a Texas bar, a law enforcement official told The Associated Press. The FBI is investigating the shooting, which erupted a day after the U.S. and Israel launched an attack on Iran, as a potential act of terrorism.

item.title: U.S., Israel pound Iran as Trump signals willingness to talk to new leadership after Khamenei's death
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates — The U.S. and Israel pounded targets across Iran on Sunday, dropping massive bombs on the country's ballistic missile sites and wiping out warships as part of an intensifying military campaign following the killing of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

item.title: 3 U.S. troops killed and 5 are seriously wounded during Iran attacks, military says
item.description: WASHINGTON — Three American service members have been killed and five others seriously wounded during the U.S. attacks on Iran, the military announced Sunday, marking the first American casualties in a major offensive that President Donald Trump said could likely lead to more losses in the coming weeks.
